presence.observation: Official Mexican Starbucks site publishes country menu products and named-size calories. This does not establish every branch or complete macros.

presenceUpserts.limitations: 38 named-size calorie-only hot-drink servings. Macro-constrained results cannot treat unknown protein, carbohydrate, fat, fibre, sugar or sodium as zero. Default Mexican recipes only; not every live menu item or location.

sources.captureMethod: official public rendered category with embedded product subtitles
sources.coverage: 38 explicitly named-size calorie entries across11 products in the captured13-product hot-drinks category. Two unsized espresso products withheld.
sources.limitations: Calories-only source, not complete macros or whole menu. Source zero is retained as reported kcal, never translated into zero protein/carbohydrate/fat. No volume, custom milk/syrup effects, local availability or image rights inferred.
